name: Mention a Slack bot to size and preview prospects in Argorant

parameters.content:
## Mention a Slack bot to size and preview prospects in Argorant

### How it works
Ask for a market in the channel where the team talks about it. When someone mentions the Slack app, the message (without the mention) goes to an AI agent on your own chat model. The agent uses free Argorant tools: count, a short masked preview, save as list and credits left. The answer is posted as a reply in the same thread, and the thread is the agent's memory, so follow-up questions work. The agent cannot spend credits, send email or launch campaigns.

Argorant actions here are free. Your model provider bills its own usage.

### Setup
1. Install the community node **n8n-nodes-argorant** (tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.46.6): Settings > Community nodes > Install. Guide: https://github.com/argorant/n8n-nodes-argorant
2. Add an **Argorant API** credential with a key from Argorant (Settings, API keys).
3. Create a Slack app with the app_mention event and chat:write, add the Slack credential to **Slack mention** and **Reply in the thread**, and invite the app to the channel.
4. Pick a chat model in **Chat model** (any chat model node works).
5. Activate and mention the app.

### Customization
Restrict the trigger to one channel, or add Company tools for account research.

## Your AI model
Any chat model node works. Each Slack thread is one conversation.

## Argorant tools
Free tools only: count, preview, save list, credits.

options.systemMessage: You help a sales team find prospects in Argorant. Turn the request into filters (job titles, industry in plain words, countries, states, cities, keywords). Call Count leads first, then Preview leads for a short sample. Save a list only when the user asks for it. Never invent people or numbers. Answer in at most six short lines. You cannot send emails or launch campaigns.
